text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to "Win a European GⅠ for the First 
Time"—with that goal in mind, the Trainer 
suggested a new race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The 1,300m sprint GⅠ, the Prix Maurice de 
Gheest. A race of destiny, for which I 
feel such deep, kindred sympathy...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The date falls before the Prix Jacques Le 
Marois. Because of that, if you win first, 
some may say you stole Taiki's thunder.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The Prix Jacques Le Marois or the Prix 
Maurice de Gheest—I'll make my choice 
after running the Yasuda Kinen!"
